sourceOfRules.finance: 45 CFR 1611.2(i) noncash exclusion; MVLP's approved income guideline table not yet supplied
sourceOfRules.citizenship: 45 CFR 1626.6 attestation for applicants claiming citizenship; noncitizen categories reviewed confidentially per 45 CFR 1626.5
sourceOfRules.documents: Mississippi self-representation expungement clinic; approved pleading and verification requirements unchanged
sourceOfRules.records: MVLP is the system of record for its case file; LegalEase holds the working copy under MVLP's authorization

finance.note: Until MVLP supplies its approved income guideline and asset policy, every application's financial review outcome is manual review by the MVLP program reviewer. No 125% or 200% rule is installed.

service.acceptanceAuthority: MVLP program reviewer records program eligibility; an MVLP volunteer attorney records the attorney review; both are separate from legal eligibility and packet readiness
service.note: Program decline is not a determination that record relief is unavailable.
